sloka: एवम् स कृपणम् तत्र पर्यदेवयत असकृत् ।ततः अस्मै कर्तुम् उदकम् प्रवृत्तः सह भार्यया ॥२-६४-४७॥
transliteration: evam sa kṛpaṇam tatra paryadevayata asakṛt ।tataḥ asmai kartum udakam pravṛttaḥ saha bhāryayā ॥2-64-47॥

translations.english: In this way the ascetic piteously wailed again and again. Thereafter, he with his wife set about to perform the funeral obsequies of their son.
